text:
Sam P Hey docs team — quick heads up, ran linkchecker against runtime onboarding and found a couple of issues (low severity but visible to new hires): /guides/kv-cache -> 404, and onboarding screenshot returned 403. Anyone owns runtime/onboarding?
Docs Bot LinkChecker results: 2 broken links found in /runtime/onboarding. Items: 1) /guides/kv-cache (404) 2) /assets/onboarding/screenshot.png (403). Auto-filed GH issue #4321.
Anita V I'm the owner for runtime/onboarding, thanks for flagging. I can take this today — where did the kv-cache page move to?
Sam P I think it was renamed a while back — /guides/cache-optimization is the new path. Also for the image, maybe the S3 ACL got tightened.
Sam P Quick proposal: replace screenshot with the new one at /assets/screenshots/onboarding-v2.png and update the anchor to `#kv-caching`. I can open a PR if that speeds things up.
Anita V Please open the PR and assign to me. Also can we add a 301 from /guides/kv-cache -> /guides/cache-optimization to avoid future 404s?
Raj Infra FYI: we rolled a bucket policy change last week that removed public-read from some legacy objects — that explains the 403. I can either rehost the image to the docs CDN or flip a temporary public-read for 24h. Which do you prefer?
Anita V Rehost to CDN is preferable long term. Raj, can you upload to docs-cdn path and post the URL here? If a quick temp fix is easier, public-read for 24h is OK while the PR lands.
Megan Can we also add runtime/onboarding to the daily link-scan group? This seemed like it slipped through.
Docs Bot Scheduled scans: KB group B runs daily at 02:00 UTC. Added /runtime/onboarding to group B scans.
Katie L While you're in the file, tiny copy ask — under "Caching" can we mention prefix/KV caching explicitly (one-liner). Makes the section less ambiguous for engineers.
Sam P PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5893 — includes: swap screenshot to onboarding-v2, update anchor to #kv-caching, small H2 copy tweak, and changelog entry. Assigned to @AnitaV and @KatieL for review.
Anita V Reviewing now. I want to run the runtime doc build and a quick smoke of the TOC, should be done in ~2h.
Raj Infra Rehosted image to CDN: https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/onboarding-v2.png — HTTP 200 confirmed. Left header metadata for cache-control.
Megan Thanks Raj, and thanks Sam for PR. When this merges can we trigger a docs deploy? Prefer not to leave staging/prod out of sync for too long.
Sam P docs-deploy-bot deploy queued for staging. :rocket:
docs-deploy-bot deploy-bot Deploy started to staging at 18:45 UTC.
Docs Bot Deployment succeeded to staging at 18:52 UTC. Prod deploy queued.
Anita V Merged the PR after a quick pass. Prod deploy looks fine from my side.
Docs Bot Prod deploy succeeded at 19:05 UTC — fixes are live.
Katie L Follow-up: I added a one-line test to the linkcheck rule set in the same PR to reduce noise for renamed pages. Should cut down duplicate GH issues. :thumbsup:
Sam P Thanks everyone — appreciated. :tada:
